cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've decided you're qualified to letter our wedding place cards. Eighty names could show what you can do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just design one? Copying eighty names is miserable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll allow you to leave the list to me. I'll read; you make each name beautiful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not at my wedding. Purple has my approval, and she can bring objections to me. Would you like the pen?
